race.description: Cda Eastland Country Boosted Mdn Hcp
race.comment: MISS TRUMP (11) returns and will find this first-up effort much easier than her debut back in March when contesting the G2 Reisling Stakes at Randwick. Fitter for a lead-up trial and gets a key booking in Looker. Expect her to be right there at the business end. MARKWELL EMMY (3) is a Spieth filly on debut for the Burges camp. Hit the line nicely in her lead-up trial and is drawn the A1. Bright start anticipated. FRATIANNO (7) returns and it's worth noting he filled a minor placing when resuming from a spell last prep at Tamworth. Now under the care of new trainer Colt Prosser. In the mix. CHEATING LILIBET (2) has not appeared since she finished a head away in third on debut over 1000m at Walcha on February 6. Have to include.
